scope: Actual common browser source served by local HTTP with authenticated API fixtures; no OEM execution or hardware qualification is claimed.
native_asset_stream: Every compressed byte for all seven descriptors read through bounded callbacks and matched to deterministic gzip assets
recovery_checks: Both viewport sizes: preparation checkpoint visibility, no automatic command, explicit resume cancellation/confirmation, invalid available:false checkpoint discard, new-program inhibition, Stop while not ready and no recovery-panel overflow.
history_cadence_export: Each of six browser cases downloads selected older session1 at60000ms while the newest inventory session2 is300000ms; JSON retains the older interval and named sensor schema.
maintenance_and_controls: Each model displays its own care guidance and manual. PicoStill fan 2 blocks disabling or speeds under 61% while pumping. PicoFerm displays its configured sampling interval. Z program names and identifiers are checked before saving.
z_controls: Both viewport sizes check that native Starting and Stopping disable pause/resume, Running enables them, and a new exported Program Maker file records an explicitly selected unit. Resume also requires the brewer to report ready with the filter inserted.
z_recipe_import: Desktop and mobile import both the native recipe and the API envelope, preserve a zero drain, discard the source brewer revision when creating a copy, and reject ambiguous or invalid files without altering the open recipe.
